notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Peregrine Drake.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake.
When the Peregrine Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.
